asr.full_text: This is what investors need to KNOW now! Can a SINGLE upgrade determine your profits until 2030? With Polygon, that might just happen. With Polygon 2.0 and the AGG-layer, a NEW phase begins, and many investors do not understand what is truly at stake. I will explain to you what changes technically, how it affects and what you should do NOW. The decision at the end of the video could be your big opportunity. So what exactly has happened with Polygon. Now there is the Napoli update. Polygon has successfully completed the so-called Napoli update. This improves, scalability efficiency, and is particularly relevant for a layer two solutions for Ethereum. Then there's the AGG layer main net launch in February. This is now live. An aggregation solution for cross-chain communication with Ethereum as the FineLity anchor. Usage, transactions, data and liquidity flow seamlessly between the blockchains. Then the integration of AUSD. The native or stablecoin AUSD has been integrated into the AGG layer. This means unified liquidity, faster and cheaper transactions across chains. Then Polygon 2.0 and the POLL migration. The migration from Matic to Polygon has been successfully carried out. POLL will take on the central TOT role as gas and staking token in 2025. Especially important in the new POS network and in the AGG layer, Polygon 2.0 is building a network of aggregated, modular blockchains with support for zk-rollups, optimistic-rollups and supernets via the chain development kit. All these news could really make Polygon explode and position them extremely well for the future. Because recently it has been quite quiet around Polygon. Stop. If you appriciate news videos about Altcoins, then feel free to leave a like. This supports my channel, and lets me know that you enjoy the content. Thank you very much for your support! So, why is all of this actually so relevant? Technological advancement. With the AGG Layer, Polygon positions itself as a central Web3 infrastructure. A game changer for interoperability than economic relevance. With the AGG layer, Polygon positions itself as a central web 3 infrastructure, a game changer for interoperability than economic relevance. The integration of Ausd naturally strengthens liquidity. More usage, more fees, more value for stakers, from an investor's perspective, great as a new central token now offers a clear utility, staking gas fees, voting rights, Napoli and the agg layer show that polygon not only has a vision but also delivers we are now looking at the potential impacts on the price in the short term sideways movements are possible as much has already been priced in. in the medium to long term however it is a bullish scenario. if adoption by apps and protocols increases polygon is consistently developing towards a modular Web3 ecosystem. The combination of ZK technologies, interoperability and token restructuring makes Pol highly interesting for forward-thinking investors in the long run. Why are Polygon holders sitting on a gold mine? If you now want to know how Polygon is really performing, then I have here the analyses of polygon with my 20 metrics, and at the end, as always, there are price scenarios, and then we'll see each other in the next video.
